title: Investigate intermittent API 26 typedTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation failure
findings_note: S22 on API 26 (s08_api26): NavigationTest.typedTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation failed 2 of 10 full-suite runs; the Name field was empty after recreate(). Unlike editingTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation, the test does not assert the typed text before recreate(), so a test race is possible; lost user input is not ruled out. Owner: investigate the app first.
boundary: Not in this slice: other test changes, unrelated editor refactors, and S22 walkthrough rows.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S22's gate needs a clean instrumented suite on API 26. NavigationTest.typedTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation failed 2 of 10 runs with the Name field empty after recreate(). Either typed input can be lost on recreation (a user-facing defect) or the test races. The owner asked to investigate the app first.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: app/src/androidTest/java/com/squalor/consecutor/NavigationTest.kt; app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/TrackerEditorDialog.kt and ui/EditorDialog.kt only if a defect is shown.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. On the API 26 emulator with the debug build and an idle host, open the create dialog, type a name, and recreate the activity about 20 times by rotation and configuration change; check the Name field each time.
2. If input is ever lost, find why the rememberSaveable state does not survive and fix it; keep the test unchanged.
3. If it never reproduces, make the test assert the typed text before recreate(), like editingTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation, and record that the app was not shown to lose input.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: 10 consecutive full-suite runs on API 26 pass 56/56 via am instrument; one run on API 36 passes; testDebugUnitTest and lintDebug pass. Record the repro result and the cause or remaining uncertainty.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when asked; use the project slice worktree workflow.
